audit_items.proof_trace: No validation enforces that BLOB_SCHEDULE[].MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK values are <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK (4096). The initBPOSchedule function (L607-617) and prepare function (L528-568) only check MaxBlobsPerBlock > math.MaxUint32, allowing config values between 4096 and 4294967295 to be accepted and used at runtime.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker provides a malicious config.yaml with BLOB_SCHEDULE entry MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK: 5000. The node accepts this config but SSZ deserialization will fail for any block with >4096 commitments, creating a validation inconsistency where the runtime check (payload.go:238-240) uses the inflated config value while the protocol enforces 4096.
